tone.target: articulate Mesa/Boogie prog metal crunch with tight palm-mutes and liquid lead sustain
tone.profile: articulate Mesa/Boogie prog metal crunch with tight palm-mutes and liquid lead sustain
tone.summary: A high-gain, mid-focused signal chain using the Recti amp model and a Distortion pedal for tight rhythm tones, complemented by a Chorus (used sparingly) and Digital Delay for lead work.
corrections: make rhythms tighter and less scooped
keep delay on leads, not all parts

rig.name: Dream Theater-Metropolis - Part I_ _The Miracle and the Sleeper_ - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Tighten the high-gain rhythm by eliminating hum and noise.
Provide clean boost for lead lines and add punch to rhythm parts.
blocks.gap: A dedicated Tube Screamer or similar mid-hump pedal would be ideal, but Boost serves the function of adding controlled gain/midrange lift.

blocks.purpose: Establish the core high-gain crunch and tight palm-mute rhythm tone.
blocks.gap: While a dedicated Mesa/Boogie model would be perfect, Distortion provides the necessary aggressive gain structure for prog metal.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the massive, tight, and mid-focused sound characteristic of Mesa/Boogie amps.
Provide a robust and articulate 4x12 cabinet sound suitable for high-gain metal.
Sculpt the tone to emphasize mids and maintain note separation, avoiding low-end muddiness.
Add subtle, liquid texture to lead lines without sounding like a 'wash', fulfilling the sustain requirement.
Provide subtle echo for lead lines to enhance sustain and space.
Add a subtle sense of space and depth to the overall mix without muddying the attack.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR to better capture the articulate, high-gain character required for prog metal leads and rhythm.

proposals.reason: The current UK cab is generic; a specific high-gain IR will improve articulation and tone accuracy.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and definition in the upper mids/highs.
